title: morpheus.model/v1
description: Canonical model metadata for the Morpheus ModelRegistry. This schema defines the descriptive field set the on-chain CanonicalModel stores as the source of truth (capability, featureFlags, free-form tags, limits, upstream provenance). It also serves as the shape CICD validates a model proposal against before the operator registers it on-chain. The contract version-locks to this schema via schemaVersion.

schemaVersion.description: Version-lock token. The contract records which schema versions it accepts and rejects writes that do not conform.

canonicalName.description: Normalized display name. SHOULD match an upstream canonical id (OpenRouter / models.dev / LiteLLM) so downstream matching works; Morpheus-specific suffixes are appended (see morpheusSuffixes).

upstream.description: Provenance from an external canonical registry, used by CICD validation to confirm the model exists in the wild before registration.

morpheusSuffixes.description: Morpheus-added variants on top of the upstream model, e.g. ':tee', ':thinking', ':non-thinking'. Where a suffix changes routing it must also be expressed as a feature flag on-chain.

capability.description: Model TYPE. Exactly one. Mirrors the on-chain ModelCapability enum, which is owner-extensible at runtime (this list may grow without a schema change for routing purposes).

features.description: Boolean capability flags that mirror the on-chain featureFlags bitmask (e.g. TEE_REQUIRED, TEE_OPTIONAL, TOOL_CALLING, VISION, REASONING, STREAMING_ONLY).

tags.description: Free-form discovery labels stored on-chain but ungoverned (no on-chain tag registry) and never used for contract branching; purely for UX/search.

limits.description: Capacity metadata, ideally cross-checked against the upstream source in CICD.

spec.description: Per-capability detail block. e.g. LLM { contextWindow, maxOutputTokens, toolCalling, vision, reasoning }, EMBEDDING { dimensions }, STT/TTS { languages, sampleRate }, IMAGE { resolutions }.
